method: Exact R3 CAD frames ported from Python; six-input bounded inverse kinematics. No force or tendon dynamics.

grid.description: Side offsets −20, −10, 0, +10, +20 mm; depth offsets −6, 0, +6 mm; height offsets −4, 0, +4 mm from the centre target. Fixed 12 mm cube orientation.

limits: These are nominal pad-point checks, not a continuous workspace guarantee. Dense CAD collisions, cable routing and physical holding require separate checks.
